chapter_seo_title: Han Li Takes on the Black Fiend Sect’s Blood Servant – Chapter 311
chapter_meta_description: Han Li reveals his mid-Foundation power, slaughtering Black Fiend Sect cultists before their formation can complete. But the Blood Servant’s blood-light transformation proves a tougher nut to crack.
og_title: Han Li vs the Blood Servant
og_description: A fast-paced crowd control chapter where Han Li dismantles the Black Fiend Sect’s ritual while facing an invulnerable blood-light sphere.
twitter_title: Han Li’s ruthless takedown of the Black Fiend Sect
twitter_description: Han Li shows why you never let a formation finish—brutal efficiency in Chapter 311.

lore_anchors.definition: A multi-cultivator ritual array that generates a domain effect to pin down a higher-tier enemy; highly effective but requires setup time and coordination.
A title for a cultivator enhanced through blood-path techniques, often serving as a direct subordinate of a blood-cultivation Sect Leader.
A high-quality defensive artifact that can block punches from a blood-light enhanced opponent, though it suffers visible damage.
A set of top-grade flying blades used by Han Li; a classic concealed weapon with high lethality.
Another top-grade offensive artifact in Han Li’s arsenal, likely a capturing or striking-type tool.
A devastating ritual flame technique encountered earlier at a spirit stone mine, capable of consuming everything; its summoning ritual bears strong resemblance to the Black Wind Formation’s setup.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li leave the barrier to attack the cultists directly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognizes the banner ritual as a threat similar to the Green Sun Demon Flame, which must be stopped before it completes; his allies can hold the barrier for the moment.
It seems highly resistant to top-grade artifacts, but such transformations often have drawbacks like reduced mobility or mana exhaustion.
